info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/boogu-image/edit
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/boogu-image/edit queue.

output_format.description: The format of the generated image.
output_format.title: Output Format

num_images.description: The number of edited images to generate.
num_images.title: Num Images

image_size.description: The output size. If omitted, the edited image follows the input image aspect ratio while respecting the model's 2K native limit.
image_size.title: Image Size

guidance_scale.description: Controls how closely the edit follows the text instruction. Higher values stick more closely to the prompt.
guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale

examples: Change the background to a sunny garden while preserving the person.
帮我在这幅画右下角加上三个带叶子的柿子。
prompt.description: The edit instruction describing how to transform the input image. Boogu-Image supports English and Chinese instructions.
prompt.title: Prompt

image_url.description: URL of the input image to edit.
image_url.title: Image Url

seed.description: The same seed, prompt, and input image given to the same version of the model will output the same image every time.
seed.title: Seed

enable_safety_checker.description: If true, the safety checker is run on the input and output images. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked, and images flagged as unsafe are returned as black images.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

negative_prompt.description: Describes what should NOT appear in the edited image. Used for classifier-free guidance; leave empty to disable text negative guidance.
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

cfg_range_end.description: End of the timestep fraction over which CFG is applied.
cfg_range_end.title: Cfg Range End

num_inference_steps.description: The number of denoising steps to perform.
num_inference_steps.title: Num Inference Steps

image_guidance_scale.description: Reference-image guidance strength. A value of 1.0 disables image CFG; higher values preserve the input image more strongly.
image_guidance_scale.title: Image Guidance Scale

sync_mode.description: If true, the media is returned as a data URI and the output is not available in the request history.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

cfg_range_start.description: Start of the timestep fraction over which CFG is applied.
cfg_range_start.title: Cfg Range Start

seed.description:
Seed of the generated Image. It will be the same value of the one passed in the
            input or the randomly generated that was used in case none was passed.
seed.title: Seed

has_nsfw_concepts.description: Whether the generated images contain NSFW concepts.
has_nsfw_concepts.title: Has Nsfw Concepts

prompt.description: The prompt used for generating the image.
prompt.title: Prompt

height.description: The height of the generated image.
height.title: Height

width.description: The width of the generated image.
width.title: Width

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
